items.description: Implement Pong rules, bounded computer movement, legal win/loss replays, controls, rendering and audio routing; preserve existing games.
items.verify: Run all tests; require nonempty Pong engine/UI groups; fail discovery errors and report skips. Cover every brief rule, transition and failure path.

items.description: Check the real Pong terminal loop and cleanup.
items.verify: PTY exercises movement, serve, pause/restart, mute, resize in play/pause, Q and SIGINT; compare states, restored modes and child cleanup; retain Pong evidence.

items.description: Provide the documented Pong module command.
items.verify: Help succeeds without a terminal; test suite verifies CLI flags and nonterminal errors.

items.description: Check actual reused macOS sample playback.
items.verify: Run existing native playback/metering tests; require at least two cases, macOS and no skips. This does not establish listening quality.

argv: import os,sys,unittest; assert sys.platform == 'darwin', 'Native playback requires this trial macOS host'; os.environ['NEON_TETRIS_AUDIO_TESTS']='1'; suite=unittest.defaultTestLoader.discover('tests', pattern='test_native_audio.py'); assert suite.countTestCases() >= 2, 'Missing native audio tests'; result=unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(suite); sys.exit(0 if result.wasSuccessful() and result.testsRun >= 2 and not result.skipped else 1)

items.description: Inspect Pong presentation against the existing paper/jade game style.
items.verify: Retain and actually inspect terminal captures at 80x30 and 100x35 in color and monochrome, covering serve, rally, pause, win and loss. Record readability, state/score/control visibility and style comparison; do not equate snapshots with human playtesting.
